title: raid_marks
summary: MSUI carries the full MSG_RAID_TARGET_UPDATE wire (set/request outbound, single + full-list inbound parse) and maintains the 8-slot guid board with correct clear-on-leave semantics, but nothing renders a raid mark anywhere: no overhead world billboard, no target-frame icon, and the Lua-facing RaidTargetIndex helper has no caller.

openItems.text: No overhead raid-mark billboard on marked world units (Benilla raid_marks.rs: fixed 1x1 world-unit camera-facing quad from the UI-RaidTargetingIcons 4x2 atlas, seated one line-pitch above the unit's overhead name block, bare anchor when no name shows).
No nameplate/V-plate raid-icon child, and no plate-vs-billboard mutual exclusion (a plated unit should show the mark on its plate instead of the world billboard).
TargetFrame raid-target icon is explicitly classified NOT-DRAWN in Program.UnitFrames.cs:133 - a marked target shows no icon on the target frame either.
GroupUiLaw.RaidTargetIndex (the Lua-facing 1..8 index) is defined but never consumed, so no UI surface reflects the tracked board at all.
